breakdown.description: The prompt declares the layer rigid in shear, which conflicts with the request to compute a nonzero shear strain and relative lateral displacement.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification ignores the erroneous 'rigid in shear' assumption entirely and correctly computes nonzero shear strain (γ_avg = 7.656 × 10⁻⁵) and nonzero relative lateral displacement (Δ = 0.001531 mm), consistent with the ground truth prompt which omits that contradictory statement.
